[[File:Blessing_of_Oneness.png|thumb|200px|Vana-Xo applies the Blessing of Oneness to the Emperor's Wrath.]]
The '''Blessing of Oneness''' could be applied by [[Voss Mystics]] to the outsiders seeking entrance to the Halls of the Unforgotten in the [[Dark Heart]], where [[Sel-Makor]]'s influence was strong. The Blessing was one of the ways Voss were able to hold at bay the darkness of the [[Nightmare Lands]], the other was the [[Unidentified Voss purifying ritual|ritual]] of Ki-Da. The [[Emperor's Voice (Sith Empire)|Emperor's Voice]] received the blessing before entering the Dark Heart, of which the hermit [[Madaga-Ru]] was aware. Around [[3640 BBY]] Madaga-Ru sent the [[Empire's Wrath|Emperor's Wrath]] to Mystic [[Vana-Xo]] so that she could bestow the Blessing of Oneness upon the Sith as well. Vana-Xo tried to ask the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] for a measure of the life force that could be used to [[Voss healing ritual|heal]] the injured. The Wrath refused the offer, but received the Blessing nonetheless and was able to go into [[Oneness/Legends|Oneness]] in the Dark Heart.
